name: sdd
description: Issue-native spec-driven development: epic = spec, sub-issues = plan, worktree worker waves, fresh reviewer per PR. Adds agents and hooks on top of the cross-tool skills.

interface.shortDescription: Spec as an epic issue, plan as sub-issues, worker waves, reviewer per PR.
interface.longDescription: Issue-native spec-driven development on top of mattpocock/skills: to-tickets-plus hardens sub-issues with Files owned / Interfaces / Test scenarios / Verify, build-epic dispatches isolated workers in waves and gates each PR with a fresh reviewer, implement-issue runs one ticket to a PR, close-epic writes the summary. Hooks refuse to stop without a recorded Verify run and refuse to remove a worktree with unpushed work. Codex has no custom-agent slot yet, so workers are plain subagent delegations carrying the brief.
